Synthetic snapshots are invented offline rates, never live provider quotes.
Monthly inputs represent constant horizon averages; scenario ranges are not confidence intervals.
Physical space includes declared metadata and retained copies; peak assumes coexistence of all copies.
No automatic sample scaling, production throughput or cloud latency inference.
Flat linear tariffs only; no tiers, taxes, commitments allocation, free tiers or currency conversion.
Missing rates or quantities leave totals null; known subtotals exclude missing charges.
Money rounds per line to six decimal places, half even; percentages/payback to twelve.
